title: Phase Transition Checklist & Metric Staircase — Q2 Ramp
body:
Purpose:
This working sheet defines explicit phase-transition gates for product launches (pilot -> soft-roll -> full-roll). It pairs a stepwise KPI staircase with a compact checklist of engineering, SRE, customer-success, and product actions tied to each gate. The intent is to give PMs and ops a fast decision rubric for moving traffic and scaling commitments without re-running the whole launch playbook.

Summary of approach:
- Define 4 phases: Pilot (0-1% traffic), Canary (1-5%), Gradual Ramp (5-40%), Scale (40-100%).
- For each phase we specify: key signals (KPI), minimum observation window, acceptance criteria (pass / borderline / fail), required mitigations, and mandatory signoffs.
- Metric Staircase: each KPI has a three-step threshold (green / amber / red) that maps to action. The thresholds are workload-specific (chat vs embeddings) and annotated with measurement cadence.

Quick reference (single-line):
Pilot -> Canary when pilot shows sustained green for 72h on latency/errors and NPS/QA checks pass; Canary -> Gradual Ramp when 7-day SLOs remain green and cost-per-call is within expected band; Gradual Ramp -> Scale when 14-day stability and adoption metrics meet growth forecasts and SRE capacity validated.

PHASE MATRIX
Phase: Pilot (0-1%)
- Observation window: 72 hours (min)
- Primary KPIs: median p95 latency, error-rate (5xx+client errors), model-quality regression rate (eval testset), manual QA accept rate
- Metric Staircase (example):
  - Latency p95: green <= 120ms, amber 120-180ms, red >180ms
  - Error rate: green <=0.2%, amber 0.2-0.6%, red >0.6%
  - Quality regressions: green 0, amber 1-2 non-blocking, red >=3 or any blocking
  - QA accept rate: green >=95%, amber 90-95%, red <90%
- Minimum acceptance: all primary KPIs in green OR at most one amber with a documented mitigation and owner
- Mandatory checks before approval: data retention & consent verified, basic observability dashboards created, feature flags wired for fast rollback
- Owners required to sign off: PM, Eng (serving), SRE, QA lead, CS partner (if pilot involves external customer)

Phase: Canary (1-5%)
- Observation window: 7 days (rolling)
- Primary KPIs: throughput GPU utilization, tail latency (p99), per-token cost, functional regression rate on canary prompt set
- Metric Staircase:
  - p99 latency: green <= 250ms, amber 250-400ms, red >400ms
  - GPU util: green target 60-85%, amber 50-60% or 85-90%, red <50% or >90% sustained
  - Cost per 1k tokens: green within -/+10% of model baseline, amber 10-25% delta, red >25% delta
- Acceptance: no red signals for 7d and at least 80% of checkpoints green; any amber must have rolling mitigation and added test coverage
- Mandatory actions: enable finer-grained tracing for long-tail requests, run canary-specific chaos test (network jitter, degraded GPU), update routing fallback matrix
- Signoffs: PM, Infra lead, Observability, Finance (cost review)

Phase: Gradual Ramp (5-40%)
- Observation window: 14 days (rolling)
- Primary KPIs: adoption funnel (activation -> successful inference), SLA adherence, error budget burn rate, customer-impact anomalies
- Metric Staircase:
  - SLA adherence: green >=99.7% hourly, amber 99.0-99.7%, red <99.0%
  - Error budget burn: green <30% burn per 7d, amber 30-60%, red >60%
  - Funnel success rate: green within target band, amber slight dip with clear root cause, red pronounced and consistent drop
- Acceptance: 14d without red; capacity validated via load test at 1.5x expected daily peak; costing within forecasted runway
- Mandatory actions: reserve dedicated burst capacity for top-tier customers, implement KV prefix caching for high-volume routes, finalize canary-to-main model pin strategy
- Signoffs: PM, Eng, SRE, Customer Success, Sales (if ramp affects paying customers)

Phase: Scale (40-100%)
- Observation window: 21-28 days for full validation
- Primary KPIs: long-term cost per active user, retention on feature, model drift metrics, compliance/audit items complete
- Metric Staircase:
  - Cost per throughput unit: green within budget, amber up to +10%, red >+10%
  - Model drift: green low drift on sentinel prompts, amber drift requiring retrain planning, red drift impacting outputs
- Acceptance: sustained green across core KPIs with a documented capacity roadmap for next 90 days
- Mandatory actions: full runbook published, incident response contact list validated, enterprise customers notified of change windows and fallback policies
- Signoffs: executive sponsor (product head), Eng director, SRE director, Security & Compliance (if applicable), Finance lead

Operational checklist (one-row actions every phase must confirm)
- Feature flag exists and is tested for fast rollback
- Synthetic tests in CI covering canary prompt set
- Dashboards: latency, errors, cost, user-journey conversion present and shared
- Alert thresholds configured for amber -> page -> exec escalation ladder
- On-call runbook updated with phase-specific run levels
- Customer communication template prepared (pilot/canary users)

Risk & mitigation snippets (common gotchas)
- Sudden tail-latency spikes: mitigation = reduce batch window for affected route, enable fallback to smaller model variant
- Cost overshoot due to batch inefficiency: mitigation = set autoscaling caps + change scheduling window, re-run estimator with real workload sample
- Model regression after rollout: mitigation = immediate rollback via flag + open hotfix bug with triage checklist and patch window

Measurement cadence & ownership table (compact)
- Daily: latency p95/p99, error-rate, SRE oncall notes (owner: SRE lead)
- Weekly: cost per 1k tokens, adoption funnel, regression counts (owner: PM + Finance)
- Bi-weekly: user qualitative feedback summary, drift signals (owner: Product Research)
- Monthly: runway forecast and model retrain plan (owner: Product Ops)

Decision rubric shorthand (for meetings)
- Green path: metrics green => auto-progress to next phase after observation window and signoffs recorded
- Amber path: requires mitigation plan and extended observation window equal to the phase length; limited extra traffic increase (max x2 of current %) until amber clears
- Red path: immediate rollback to prior stable phase, trigger post-mortem within 72 hours, schedule follow-up gating meeting

Next steps (draft action items)
- Aisha: finalize canary prompt set and upload to S3 (due 2026-03-12)
- Julian: add p99 tracing for canary routes and publish dashboard (due 2026-03-16)
- Rhea: run 1.5x soak test and produce capacity report (due 2026-03-20)
- Diego: prepare customer-facing status templates and escalation roster (due 2026-03-18)

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally compact and assumes teams will attach detailed runbooks per product line (chat/embeddings/rerank). Use the Metric Staircase thresholds as a baseline; teams should calibrate numbers to workload characteristics and list any exceptions in the product-specific annex.
- Questions: propose any additional KPIs that should be considered phase-gating (e.g., user-reported wrong-result ratio, safety-filter false positives)

Revision history:

- 2026-03-10 reviewed: moved observation windows to align with new SRE policy (Rhea)
